Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
7:53 PM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a recent Ryzen 7 or Core Ultra 5/7 chip, and a 512 GB fast SSD.

Memory: 16 GB is the minimum for coding, browsers and containers together. Pick one that lets you upgrade to 32 GB later.
Screen and keyboard: Look for a bright, full-HD or better screen (1920x1200 if possible) and a comfortable keyboard, since you'll use them all day.
Battery and weight: Choose 8+ hours and under 1.7 kg if you carry it around. A graphics card isn't needed unless you do games or machine learning.
System: Windows suits most work. A MacBook Air usually costs more than this budget, unless you find a good offer on an older one.

I can compare real options and prices from shopping sites if you like. What do you mostly build: web and app work, data and AI, or games?
